ticket.summary: Customer reports rotten-egg/sulfur smell near gas water heater in basement (also slow floor drain, deferred) - evacuated and directed to gas utility/911, on-call paged.
mitigation_advice: Leave the building immediately with everyone and pets [PB-06]
Do not operate light switches, phones, or appliances inside [PB-06]
From outside, call the gas utility emergency line or 911 [PB-06]
ticket.customer_message: Lena - stop and treat this as a gas emergency. A rotten-egg smell near a gas water heater can mean a gas leak. Please get everyone (and pets) out of the house right now. Do NOT touch light switches, appliances, or anything electrical on your way out, and don't go back to the basement [PB-06]. Once you're outside and away from the building, call your gas utility's emergency line or 911 [PB-06]. I'm paging our on-call plumber now - we won't quote or schedule the drain work until the gas issue is cleared by the utility. We can look at the slow drain and musty smell once it's safe.
